title: The Atlas
eyebrow: Two Sons · everything mapped so far
subtitle: The whole setting on one board. Group it by region or by kind, show one part or several, search for anything, and click a card to see what it connects to and the wiki text behind it.
intro: Group by Region gives a column per region, plus Port, the Spine and Underpass, the border towns, columns for things that cross every border (the Council, the faiths, the guilds), and the world as a whole; each part of the Atlas adds its own heading under the columns it touches. Group by Kind gives a column per kind of thing (governments, dishes, festivals…), with the region on each card; kinds with only a card or two share an “other” column for their part. Use the part switches, or “only” to see one part by itself; the page address updates (for example #part=Food&group=kind), so a link can open straight to one part. Cards start closed: open one with its arrow (or open them all) to see its summary and connections. Every card of the same kind shows the same rows in the same order, and says “none stated” where the wiki gives nothing, so gaps show. Click a card's name to draw its lines and read the wiki sentence behind each connection. Dashed tags are uncertain (likely, working or possible); inferred links stay hidden until you tick the box. Nothing here is canon: the wiki page always wins.
